basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer and tabletop enthusiast currently residing in Portland, Oregon. I work as a graphic designer at a local agency and spend my evenings exploring new tabletop games on my Mac. I’m particularly fond of the Highland Games and enjoy participating in discussions about workplace culture. I'm usually online during the evenings and weekends. I'm in a relationship and enjoy sharing my gaming experiences with my partner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in graphic design and a passion for gaming, I have developed a keen eye for strategy and aesthetics in tabletop games. I learned about technology and gaming through self-teaching and community interactions, often exploring new digital tools that enhance the gaming experience.
